description: This file manages chat channel registry functions, including plugin registration, normalization, and metadata formatting.

methods.name: listRegisteredChannelPluginEntries
methods.description: Returns the list of active plugin registry channel entries.

methods.name: findRegisteredChannelPluginEntry
methods.description: Finds a registered channel plugin entry by normalized key or alias.

methods.name: findRegisteredChannelPluginEntryById
methods.description: Finds a registered channel plugin entry by plugin ID.

methods.name: normalizeChannelKey
methods.description: Normalizes a raw channel key string to lowercase trimmed form.

methods.name: normalizeAnyChannelId
methods.description: Normalizes any registered channel ID, including external plugins.

methods.name: listRegisteredChannelPluginIds
methods.description: Lists all registered channel plugin IDs.

methods.name: listRegisteredChannelPluginAliases
methods.description: Lists all aliases for registered channel plugins.

methods.name: getRegisteredChannelPluginMeta
methods.description: Retrieves metadata for a registered channel plugin by ID.

methods.name: formatChannelPrimerLine
methods.description: Formats a primer line for a chat channel meta.

methods.name: formatChannelSelectionLine
methods.description: Formats a selection line for a chat channel meta with documentation link.
